language.question: Which language should the Next.js application use?
language.rationale: The requested application is a Next.js TypeScript App Router project.

options.label: TypeScript
options.description: Typed application code with strong editor and build-time checks.

options.label: JavaScript
options.description: JavaScript application code without static typing.

framework.question: Which frontend framework and runtime should be used?
framework.rationale: The request explicitly requires a lightweight Next.js TypeScript App Router application deployable to Vercel.

options.label: Next.js App Router
options.description: Full-stack Next.js routes, server-side integrations, and Vercel deployment support.

features.question: What should this service include?
features.recommendedChoice: Dashboard; outbound Twilio Voice calls to Indian mobile numbers; TwiML Gather speech recognition webhooks; temporary in-process call state; Groq recruiter conversation, extraction, and final transcript analysis; live transcript; call history; recruiter reports; Vercel deployment configuration
features.answer: Dashboard; outbound Twilio Voice calls to Indian mobile numbers; TwiML Gather speech recognition webhooks; temporary in-process call state; Groq recruiter conversation, extraction, and final transcript analysis; live transcript; call history; recruiter reports; Vercel deployment configuration
features.rationale: These are the explicitly requested routes, integrations, POC behavior, and deployment target.

dataStores.question: Which persistent data stores are required?
dataStores.rationale: The request explicitly forbids a database and allows temporary state in process memory, with serverless limitations documented.

options.label: No datastore required
options.description: Use temporary in-process state only; data is not durable across instances or cold starts.

options.label: PostgreSQL
options.description: Durable relational storage for production call history and reports.

options.label: Redis
options.description: Shared temporary state and coordination across instances.

options.label: Blob Storage
options.description: Object storage for recordings, transcripts, or uploaded media.

auth.question: Should users sign in to access application API features?
auth.rationale: Authentication was not requested for this initial POC.

options.label: Yes
options.description: Require signed-in users before accessing application API features.

options.label: No
options.description: Keep the initial POC unauthenticated and protect provider credentials server-side.

integrations.name: Twilio Voice
integrations.purpose: Place real outbound calls to Indian mobile numbers and receive TwiML webhook events.

integrations.name: Groq
integrations.purpose: Run recruiter conversation responses, structured extraction, and final transcript analysis server-side.

integrations.name: Vercel
integrations.purpose: Deploy the Next.js application and server-side route handlers.

limitations: No mock mode and no fake calls.
No database, Redis, Docker, or microservices.
Initial POC uses TwiML Gather speech recognition.
